text:
Jordan: quick q — I'm about to apply a terraform change that bumps the inference-api statefulset from 3 -> 5 replicas and swaps the rolloutStrategy to partitioned canary. want to sanity-check the plan before i hit apply. 
Maya: which partition/weight are you planning? we should avoid >20% initially. 
Jordan: starting partition 4 (so 1 pod rotates), canary weight via annotation set to 10%. would like to also tighten maxUnavailable to 0. 
Sam: watch out: we recently had a pod start-up delay ~45s on GPU nodes. if you set maxUnavailable=0 plus a small surge you might starve capacity. maybe allow maxSurge: 1? 
Jordan: noted. config snippet i have: 
```yaml
strategy:
  type: RollingUpdate
  rollingUpdate:
    maxUnavailable: 0
    maxSurge: 1
annotations:
  rollout/canary-weight: "10"
  rollout/partition: "4"
```
Maya: looks fine. also check HPA minReplicas=2 stays in place or autoscaler will scale down during rollout and reduce effectiveness. 
Jordan: good catch. current HPA min=2. i'll keep it. also changing secret path for kms-backed credentials in terraform: `module.k8s_secrets.kms_path -> module.kms.redwood_path`. anyone recall any service depending on old path literal? 
Aisha: @Jordan there was a cronjob that used the old secret name last quarter (cron-usage-reports). i opened a quick PR to reference the new kv path but not merged. see https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/472 
Jordan: thanks @Aisha — i'll add the cronjob change to this deploy. infra-bot: can you run a dry terraform plan for me? 
infra-bot: terraform plan complete — no diffs for cloud infra modules besides `k8s_secrets.secret_data` path change. plan output: 
```
- module.k8s_secrets.kubernetes_secret.this[0]: ~ "data[\"credentials.json\"]" => replaced (forces new resource)
+ module.inference.statefulset.this: replicas: 3 => 5
```
Sam: since the secret is recreated that will rollout pods anyway. set `podTemplateSpec.metadata.annotations["kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt"]` on the statefulset to control timing if needed. 
Maya: also double-check readinessProbe timeout — we had flaps when readinessTimeout < init libs load time. bump to 10s if using gpu-init. 
Jordan: will do. plan to land PR, wait 15m, then apply and monitor latency/evictions. tagging @Sam @Maya for post-apply watch. :eyes:
Aisha: i'll queue the cronjob PR review now. 
Sam: thumbs up, i'll be on stand-by for rollback if nodes saturate. 
Jordan: thanks all — will update thread when apply is done.
